subject: Final-mile: PO & invoice timing coordination for Q3 bookings
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Kara Nguyen <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final-mile: PO & invoice timing coordination for Q3 bookings

Kara —

Thanks again for the productive conversation this week. We have Q3 bookings tied to the deployment milestone that ACME is signing; to ensure revenue recognition in September we need the PO accepted and the invoice routed to finance by the end of Aug 28 PT. 

Action items we need from your side:
- Confirm the official PO document and the exact PO number we should reference on the invoice.
- Confirm AP invoice email (accounts-payable@acme.com?) and EFT reference if applicable.
- Any vendor-specific invoice fields (cost center, project code) so we put them on the invoice exactly as your AP system expects.

Attached is our final milestone schedule for reference. Laura (cc) has the processing deadlines if you want to loop finance directly. If we miss the Aug 28 cutoff we will move recognition to the following month.

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if easier — Ben can take the scheduling.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(priym_das@redwood.com)
[Attachment: final_milestone_schedule.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Kara Nguyen <procurement@acme.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@acme.com <accounts-payable@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final-mile: PO & invoice timing coordination for Q3 bookings

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the clear note. We can move this through but need two clarifications before the PO is routed to AP:
1) Can you confirm the billing contact and the postal billing address (we require an address block on our PO form)?
2) Is Redwood going to issue a single consolidated invoice for the milestone or do you want multiple invoices per delivery item?

Once I have those pieces I will create the PO and route it to AP. I am copying our AP mailbox here so they get visibility.

Kara Nguyen
Senior Procurement Manager | ACME Corporation
procurement@acme.com

Subject: RE: Final-mile: PO & invoice timing coordination for Q3 bookings

Team —

Quick finance checklist to make the Aug 28 recognition window: please read and action. This is the gating list Laura B. will enforce for bookings to hit Sep revenue.

Required before Aug 28 11:59pm PT: 
- Signed PO from customer (scanned PDF or DocuSign) with PO number present.
- Invoicing email and remit-to details confirmed (email + EFT details when applicable).
- Invoice amount matches SOW line items or has approved deviation documented (SOW v2 or change order).
- Delivery acceptance note or milestone completion confirmation if recognition tied to acceptance.
- Billing contact for any follow-ups (name + phone/email).

If any of these are missing we will need to push recognition to the next month and file a deferred booking. Please copy finance@redwood.com on the final PO so we get it uploaded immediately — we can only process if the PO arrives in our queue by the cutoff.

DocuSign / checklist: https://app.docusign.com/1234-ACME-PO
Internal upload: https://redwoodcorp.box.com/s/po-ready-checklist

Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Thanks for the quick response. To confirm and reduce back-and-forth:
- Billing contact: Redwood AR Team (finance@redwood.com) and remit-to address is in the attached SOW.
- We will issue a single consolidated invoice for the milestone (one invoice referencing the PO number).
- PO number field is required on the invoice; please confirm the number when you issue the PO so we can match it.

Im attaching the latest SOW v2 and the consolidated invoice template we use. If AP requires a different format we can adapt but prefer to avoid multiple line items that split recognition.

Ben Carter
